summary: Focused verification of the 'footer relocation' bug fix on Vendor Management app. Verified via computed CSS + geometry (not class name) that [data-testid=top-action-bar] is now position:fixed with bottom:0 across /vendor, /bill, /final. All 11 required buttons (search, page-nav, new, save, edit, submit, approve, export, print, change-logo, logout) are descendants of the fixed bar. Export dropdown opens upward. A4 content is not clipped by the footer (shell padding-bottom = 140px). Full E2E workflow (save -> submit -> final approval) still functions from the footer and produces a vendor code matching /^AE\d{4}JV\d{4}$/. Logout returns to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: Component/class naming is misleading: the file is TopActionBar.jsx and className is 'top-action', but it now renders at the bottom. Consider renaming to BottomActionBar/.footer-action for future maintainability.

Form inputs (firmName, mobileNo, checkedByName, approvedByName, etc.) lack data-testid attributes; only field-currentStatus / field-tempRefId / field-vendorCode / approval-banner / approved-vendor-code have them. Adding data-testids would make automated tests more robust (currently the review request assumed testids that don't exist; had to fall back to placeholder selectors).
seed_data_creation: One vendor 'FOOTER_TEST' created in localStorage during E2E; approved with code AE0001JV2627.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer relocation fully verified. TopActionBar is now geometrically at the bottom (position:fixed, bottom:0). Do not confuse the .top-action class name - check computed style / geometry only. Form inputs use placeholders, not data-testids: 'Full Firm Name', 'Phone Number', 'Checker Name', 'e.g. Komal Srivastava (Account Manager)'.
